cases.prompt: Port a single-screen mobile editor to desktop without changing its navigation model.
cases.failure: A single-screen mobile navigation model is copied to desktop and ignores multiwindow work, command access, resizing, and precision input.

cases.prompt: Use the same centered phone column on an unfolded book-style device.
cases.failure: An unfolded book-style device keeps a narrow centered phone column and ignores posture, hinge occlusion, and multi-pane adaptation.

cases.prompt: Scale up a desktop streaming site and ship it to TV.
cases.failure: A desktop streaming layout is merely enlarged for television and lacks ten-foot legibility, directional focus, and remote-native interaction.

cases.prompt: Put the full phone dashboard with six charts on a watch.
cases.failure: A full phone dashboard is compressed onto a watch and overwhelms glance duration, tiny geometry, and critical-task prioritization.

cases.prompt: Allow a driver to type a long destination form while the car is moving.
cases.failure: A driver is asked to type a long destination form while moving, creating distraction and unsafe visual-manual task demand.

cases.prompt: Place many 2D settings cards all around the user in an immersive room.
cases.failure: Many flat settings panels surround the user in immersive space without accounting for comfort, field of view, depth, or reach.

cases.prompt: Enemy threat level is indicated only by red versus green HUD markers.
cases.failure: Threat level is encoded only by red and green HUD markers, making critical combat information fragile under color-perception and attention constraints.

cases.prompt: A CLI command deletes production data immediately with a cryptic flag.
cases.failure: A cryptic command-line flag immediately deletes production data without scope preview, dry-run support, or a recoverable decision boundary.

cases.prompt: A public kiosk times out mid-payment and leaves prior user data visible.
cases.failure: A public kiosk times out during payment but leaves the prior user session and sensitive data visible to the next person.
